<title level="1" right="Class Feature 11">[Mighty Rage](/Classes.aspx?ID=2)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 82

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

Your rage intensifies and lets you burst into action. Your proficiency rank for your barbarian class DC increases to expert. You gain the Mighty Rage free action.
name: Mighty Rage

<title level="1" right="Class Feature 11">[Mighty Rage](/Classes.aspx?ID=57)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 70

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

Your rage intensifies and lets you hit harder at the start of a fight. Your proficiency rank for your barbarian class DC increases to expert. In addition, when you use [Quick-Tempered](/Actions.aspx?ID=2803), the first Strike you make during your first turn deals additional damage equal to your [Rage](/Actions.aspx?ID=2802) damage.
name: Mighty Rage
